description: Protected ADTS frames at 22050 Hz of twelve channel pairs followed by SBR data, every frame with a wrong CRC: their SBR data counts for nothing and the stream stays AAC LC.
findings: 12 ADTS frames fail the CRC check

skip.faad: faad -i prints twice the rate of any ADTS stream at 24 kHz or less, whatever its frames hold.
skip.ffprobe: ffmpeg does not check ADTS CRCs, and takes the SBR data of the first frame.
skip.decode: ffmpeg does not check ADTS CRCs.
